target: crate-internal TcCtx::str_lit_to_constructor with config-consistent raw String literal construction
beneficiary: Nanoda maintainers refactoring native literal configuration or String constructor encoding
contract: With both extensions and the five required String cached names, return Some encoding Unicode scalar values in original order as String.ofList(List.cons.{0} Char (Char.ofNat (NatLit scalar)) ... (List.nil.{0} Char)); unavailable flags or cached names yield None. This is an expression-shape contract, not a semantic equivalence proof.

recipe: Read the existing empty fixture template configuration; set both flags for each cell before config.to_export_file creates the permanent DAG. Check skipped list and declaration map are empty.

For PRESENT only, insert the six leaf paths and their ancestors into permanent strings/names using insert_full, STR_HASH and ExportFile pointer tags, reusing the reviewed Nat-dispatch name helper. Refresh export.name_cache = export.dag.mk_name_cache() before opening TcCtx. ABSENT retains the unchanged empty fixture names.
Assert cache presence/absence as the fixture precondition, and export.declars.is_empty() in both states. Never seed a temporary pointer into permanent storage or fabricate declaration validity.
Inside a fresh with_ctx per cell, allocate each fixed payload. Check quick String construction is None when string_extension is false; when true require Some, Expr::StringLit and exact stored text.

Invoke str_lit_to_constructor on the valid StringPtr. StringPtr allocation itself is supported independently of the String extension; when enabled use/verify the real StringLit payload pointer. Disabled cases test the conversion API refusal, not an admitted String expression.
Require None for every cell except N1S1-PRESENT. For that cell require Some and inspect the complete shape and scalar payloads described below. No None==None equality or panic-catching shortcut.
Keep every temporary expression/pointer inside the owning TcCtx. Do not toggle flags after DAG construction, call infer/defeq/WHNF/check_declar, or synthesize a serialized export.

positive_assertions: Outer Const String.ofList has empty levels and exactly one argument.
For each expected scalar, inspect exactly List.cons with levels [Level.zero], three arguments Char, Char.ofNat(NatLit scalar), and tail; Char and Char.ofNat have empty levels and expected arity.
Read the NatLit BigUint and compare to fixed integers [65,233,119070] in order, not to values recomputed through the production conversion loop.
After all expected values, inspect exactly List.nil with levels [Level.zero] and one Char argument. The empty input immediately has this terminal shape.
Assert the list contains no extra elements and use separate expected literal sequences to avoid copying the production algorithm.
plausible_regressions: Using UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units in place of Unicode scalar values.
Dropping the reverse traversal and reversing character order.
Wrong List/Char/String name, list arity/universe or terminal shape.
Dropping a flag check so disabled Nat storage is accessed or String-disabled conversion succeeds.
Losing graceful missing-name refusal or falsely treating raw StringLit construction as reconstruction.
